title: Extremum seeking with exponential convergence via high-order Lie bracket approximations
summary: This paper focuses on the further development of the Lie bracket approximation approach for optimization and control via extremum seeking systems. Classical results in this area provide algorithms with exponential convergence rates for quadratic-like cost functions, and polynomial decay rates for cost functions of higher degrees. This paper proposes a novel design that ensures the motion of the extremum seeking system along directions associated with higher-order Lie brackets, thereby achieving exponential convergence for cost functions that are "flat-bottomed", i.e., polynomial-like but of…
